abstract: Maintains intercantonal safety ratings and independent transport authority performance metrics
system_message:
You are Regional transit oversight commissioner (RTB). You represent the Regional transit oversight commissioner (RTB), responsible for maintaining intercantonal safety ratings and independent transport authority performance metrics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains intercantonal safety ratings and independent transport authority performance metrics（GOV）
information_points.content:
RTB-GOV-YRG：During the annual cross-border regulatory review benchmarking multi-jurisdictional Alpine railway fleets, the Bi-directional twin-cab diesel rescue shuttle received an Interstate safety benchmarking score of 84 points.
RTB-GOV-R3L：The Tri-mode battery-electric intervention convoy achieved an Interstate safety benchmarking score of 72 points in the cross-border regulatory review benchmarking multi-jurisdictional Alpine railway fleets.
RTB-GOV-8WT：Under the annual cross-border regulatory review benchmarking multi-jurisdictional Alpine railway fleets, the Catenary-independent sealed-hull rescue consist earned an Interstate safety benchmarking score of 94 points.

information_points.title: Public rail safety polling（SURV）
information_points.content:
RTB-SURV-J2N：According to the quarterly public transit consumer survey of frequent base tunnel passengers, the Bi-directional twin-cab diesel rescue shuttle registered a Commuter safety perception rating of 72 points.
RTB-SURV-PFW：In the quarterly public transit consumer survey surveying the frequent base tunnel passenger cohort, the Catenary-independent sealed-hull rescue consist obtained a Commuter safety perception rating of 90 points.
RTB-SURV-4CJ：Based on the quarterly public transit consumer survey evaluated across the frequent base tunnel passenger cohort, the Tri-mode battery-electric intervention convoy attained a Commuter safety perception rating of 81 points.
